zappos.hq: Las Vegas, Nevada, USA (downtown, former City Hall building since 2013)
zappos.founded: 1999 (July) by Nick Swinmurn; Tony Hsieh and Alfred Lin joined via investor Venture Frogs (BBB business start May 1999)
zappos.ownership_notes: Amazon subsidiary since Nov 2009 (~$1.2B deal). Cut ~300 jobs (~20%) in early 2023; Zappos Unboxed store (Louisville) closed Mar 2025 and the Louisville outlet closed Dec 2025. Replaced 365-day refunds with a 60-day refund window in July 2025 (third-party reports). No sale or bankruptcy news found.
zappos.physical_stores: No – online-only; its Louisville, KY outlet closed Dec 2025 and the Zappos Unboxed store (Mall St. Matthews, Louisville) closed Mar 2025.
zappos.bbb: BBB Accredited since Jan 2005; A+; 145 complaints closed in 3 yrs; 39 reviews.
zappos.trustpilot: 1.6 TrustScore, 679 reviews; claimed (Aug 2015); replies to 98% of negative reviews.
zappos.complaints: Slow refunds (30+ days after returns arrive), hard-to-reach/unhelpful service, loss of the old 365-day policy and exchanges, missed delivery dates, occasional worn/defective items; BBB also cites account closures after gift-card redemptions and 'delivered but not received' orders.
zappos.returns: Within 60 days; unworn/unused, unwashed, original packaging with tags (undamaged shoe box); free UPS return label; after 60 days store credit only in limited cases; guest orders 60 days, refund to original payment; non-compliant returns risk up to 50% restocking fee. Seen 2026-09-29.
zappos.shipping: Free standard shipping (3–5 business days) on all US orders, no minimum; VIP members get free 1–3 day expedited. Seen 2026-09-29.
zappos.price_match: Yes: before ordering, matches a qualifying US retailer's price plus standard shipping for the same brand/color/size (via phone/chat); excludes auction, membership, outlet, discount, third-party and Amazon Marketplace sellers and coupons/site-wide promos; plus 10-day refund if Zappos' own price drops. Seen 2026-09-29.
zappos.verdict_reason: Large Amazon-owned retailer since 1999 with BBB accreditation and A+; poor Trustpilot reflects slower refunds and a tighter 2025 return policy, not legitimacy.
